description: Use this to find a company by name or part of its domain (query), or to build a list of companies by sector, business model, B2B or B2C, technology used or headquarters country. Returns up to 20 company summaries per page, with how many email addresses were found for each. Use lookup_company for one company's full record, and get_technologies to page through every company using one tool. Works without an API key; no contact reveals.

country.description: Headquarters country, ISO-2 code such as US or GB

query.description: Company name or domain fragment, e.g. 'notion' or 'stripe.com'. Used on its own; filters below are ignored when set.

sector.description: Industry sector, exact label from the list

size.description: Estimate, not headcount: a band by how many people and addresses we found on the company's own website: micro (1-5), small (6-20), medium (21-60), large (61+). Large companies often publish few, so do not use it to exclude them.

vertical.description: Vertical inside the sector, free text as stored, e.g. 'B2B SaaS'

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
